children: Cosmo Developments, a joint venture between Abu Dhabi-based Flag Holding Group and Reportage Group, has launched a 6 billion UAE dirhams ($1.63 billion) mixed-use residential development on Yas Island.

The Wadi master plan, located along Yas Canal, covers 140,700 square metres (sqm) and will include 3,950 residential units, commercial, recreational and sports facilities, and a hotel, the state-owned WAM news agency reported.
Reportage Group will oversee the development and delivery through to long-term management.

The Wadi is designed to contribute to Abu Dhabi’s growing appeal as a destination for residents, investors and visitors, said Andrea Nucera, Managing Director at Cosmo Developments and Group Managing Director at Reportage Group

title: Cosmo launches new $1.6bln mixed-use project on Abu Dhabi’s Yas Island
